name: Terminator v2z0
summary: A multi-signal martingale-style EA that opens positions based on one of six selectable signal types (MACD, Pivot, Support/Resistance, i_Trend+RSI, i_Trend+RSI+Stochastic, i_Trend+RSI+Stochastic+MFI). It employs aggressive position scaling by doubling lots on subsequent entries when price moves against the position, then switching to 1.5x multiplication after a configurable count, with a trailing stop for exit management.
summary_zh: 这是一个多信号马丁格尔风格EA，基于六种可选信号类型之一（MACD、支点、支撑阻力、i_Trend+RSI、i_Trend+RSI+随机指标、i_Trend+RSI+随机指标+MFI）开仓。当价格逆向波动时，通过后续加仓时翻倍手数来摊低成本，超过设定次数后切换为1.5倍乘数，并使用移动止盈进行出场管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于多指标信号确认开仓，支持六种不同的信号源，包括MACD动量、支点水平、支撑阻力突破以及i_Trend指标与RSI、随机指标、MFI的多种组合。入场条件为选定信号源发出买入或卖出信号，且无反向信号时开仓。出场条件包括初始止盈、加仓后重新计算的加权平均止盈，以及可选的移动止损。仓位管理采用马丁格尔式递增加仓：前DoubleCount次加仓手数为起始手数乘以2的幂次，之后改为1.5倍递增，每次加仓间距为Pips点数。资金管理方面，当Lots设为0时根据账户自由保证金和MaximumRisk参数计算手数。加仓后止盈按持仓加权均价加上TakeProfit2点数重新计算，最后一次加仓时设置止损。移动止损功能在价格朝有利方向移动后将止损移至保本以上。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on multi-indicator signal confirmation for trade entry, supporting six different signal sources including MACD momentum, Pivot levels, Support/Resistance breakouts, and various combinations of i_Trend with RSI, Stochastic, and MFI. Entry conditions trigger when the selected signal source produces a buy or sell signal without a conflicting opposite signal. Exit conditions include initial take-profit, recalculated weighted-average take-profit after additional entries, and an optional trailing stop. Position sizing employs martingale-style progressive scaling: the first DoubleCount additional entries multiply the starting lot by powers of 2, then switching to 1.5x multiplication thereafter, with each add-on requiring a minimum adverse price movement of Pips points. Money management calculates lot size from account free margin and MaximumRisk when the Lots parameter is set to zero. After adding positions, take-profit is recalculated as the volume-weighted average entry price plus TakeProfit2 points, and a stop-loss is only set on the final MaxCount entry. The trailing stop function moves the stop-loss to breakeven or better once price moves favorably.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description: 固定手数，为0时按风险计算
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size; 0 to calculate by risk

parameters.name: MaximumRisk
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage; effective when Lots is 0

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points; 0 to disable

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: First position take profit in points

parameters.name: TakeProfit2
parameters.description: 加仓后加权均价止盈点数
parameters.description_en: Weighted average take profit in points after adding positions

parameters.name: MaxCount
parameters.description: 同方向最大加仓次数，-1为无限制
parameters.description_en: Max add-on count per direction; -1 for unlimited

parameters.name: Trailing
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points; 0 to disable

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: 指标计算使用的K线偏移
parameters.description_en: Bar offset used for indicator calculation

pros: 支持六种信号源切换，策略灵活性高，可适应不同市场环境
采用面向对象设计，信号类继承结构清晰，便于扩展新的信号类型
加仓后重新计算加权均价止盈，逻辑合理，确保整体持仓盈利目标
包含止损检查、最小止损距离验证等风控措施
pros_en: Supports six switchable signal sources, providing high strategy flexibility for different market conditions
Uses object-oriented design with clean signal class inheritance, making it easy to extend with new signal types
Recalculates volume-weighted average take-profit after adding positions, ensuring coherent profit targets for the overall position
Includes stop-loss validation and minimum stop-level checks as risk control measures
cons: 马丁格尔式加仓策略风险极高，连续逆向波动会导致手数指数级增长，可能爆仓
止损仅在最后一次加仓时设置，前期加仓均无止损保护，面临单边行情巨大风险
MaxCount设为-1时无加仓次数限制，极端行情下亏损无上限
CSigi_TrendRSISto类中m_buy被错误地赋值为卖出条件（复制粘贴bug），导致该信号类型完全失效
SolveLots函数的风险计算方式过于简化，未考虑杠杆和品种点值
cons_en: Martingale-style position scaling carries extreme risk; consecutive adverse moves cause exponential lot growth that can blow the account
Stop-loss is only set on the final MaxCount entry, leaving all prior additions without stop-loss protection against strong trends
MaxCount=-1 allows unlimited additions, creating unbounded loss potential in extreme market conditions
CSigi_TrendRSISto class has a copy-paste bug where m_buy is assigned the sell condition, making that signal type completely non-functional
SolveLots risk calculation is oversimplified, not accounting for leverage and tick value per symbol
improvements: 修复CSigi_TrendRSISto中m_buy的赋值bug，将第741行的m_buy改为正确的买入条件而非复制m_sell的条件
为每次加仓都设置止损，而非仅在最后一次加仓时设置，降低无保护持仓风险
加入最大账户风险限制和最大总持仓手数限制，防止马丁格尔加仓失控
加仓逻辑中应考虑点差和手续费成本，当前加权均价止盈未计入交易成本
improvements_en: Fix the m_buy assignment bug in CSigi_TrendRSISto where line 741 incorrectly assigns the sell condition to m_buy instead of the proper buy condition
Set stop-loss on every additional entry rather than only on the final MaxCount entry, reducing unprotected position risk
Add maximum account risk limits and maximum total position lot caps to prevent martingale scaling from spiraling out of control
Incorporate spread and commission costs into the weighted-average take-profit calculation, as the current formula ignores transaction costs

risk_points: 马丁格尔式2倍加仓策略，手数指数级增长，连续逆向波动极易爆仓
前期加仓无止损保护，单边行情下亏损无下限
CSigi_TrendRSISto信号存在bug，买入信号实际执行卖出逻辑
MaxCount可设为-1无限制，风险完全不受控
risk_points_en: Martingale-style 2x lot doubling causes exponential position growth,easily blowing the account during sustained adverse moves
No stop-loss on early additions leaves positions unprotected with unlimited downside in trending markets
CSigi_TrendRSISto signal bug causes buy signal to execute sell logic instead
MaxCount=-1 option removes all limits on position scaling, creating completely uncontrolled risk
